about: The postcommunio of the formulary “13th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Having received Your heavenly sacrament, O Lord, may we make progress, we beseech You, toward our everlasting salvation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
